ai_review.summary: Soundboard partial second set featuring Jerry shredding solos on Cold Rain & Snow and Samson & Delilah, with solid audio quality.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clean soundboard capture of the missing second‑set tracks, highlighting Jerry Garcia’s soaring solo work on Cold Rain & Snow and Samson & Delilah. Reviewers appreciate finally having these performances in their entirety and note no technical flaws, making it a valuable addition for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed 4‑star review; praise focuses on strong performance (especially Jerry) and the value of a clean soundboard, leading to a rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Partial second‑set soundboard capture; no reported clarity or mix issues, considered a solid source by the reviewer.
